answer: ZK proof of post-epoch generation at the lagoon: each agent submits a proof tied to a unique epoch seed, so replaying identities requires re-running generation per ID. A violet ledger tags each proof to its seed; duplicates collapse. The ledge is the cost wall: ~40 CPU-hours plus $15 GPU spend per fake ID, so 1,000 sybils burn $15k and 40k hours. Returns stay negative, so farming stops. It works because scarcity shifts from registration to per-epoch compute.
